hypotheses.O0_basis_fit_is_label_free: ICA and varimax use only weight-derived vocabulary loadings; semantic labels are consulted only after every basis is frozen.
hypotheses.O1_sparse_objective_improves_kurtosis: The better sparse basis exceeds the random-rotation p95 held-out absolute excess kurtosis.
hypotheses.O2_sparse_objective_improves_weight_sema: The better sparse basis exceeds native HOSVD median held-out vocabulary AUROC by at least 0.03.
hypotheses.O3_sparse_objective_is_semantically_priv: The better sparse basis exceeds the random-rotation p95 median vocabulary AUROC by at least 0.03.
hypotheses.O4_sparse_coordinates_are_reproducible: Independent vocabulary halves recover coordinates with greedy mean absolute cosine at least 0.80.
hypotheses.O5_discovered_objectives_are_diverse: The better sparse basis selects at least five distinct held-out vocabulary predicates.
hypotheses.O6_natural_semantics_transfer: The better sparse basis reaches median held-out AUROC at least 0.70 for labels selected from natural FineWeb adjoints.
